shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^export.*(House|Squares4|Folder|FileText|Magnifier|Plus|Moon|Sun|Ellipsis|Pencil|Xmark|Link|LayoutHeader|Rocket|Bolt)'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -n 'onUpdate|checked' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n -A 25 'interface Progress' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts; rg -n -- '--gn-aside-header-size|width:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -20; cat index.html; cat tsconfig.json"
